preconditions.description: The input contains at least 2 lines (n and n city lines).
The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in ['B', 'R', 'P'] for _, c in cities)
preconditions.description: Each city type is one of 'B' (Byteland), 'R' (Berland), or 'P' (disputed).

preconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x, _ in cities)
preconditions.description: City coordinates are within the range [-10^9, 10^9].
Cities are given in strictly increasing order of their coordinates.

preconditions.expression: len(set(x for x, _ in cities)) == len(cities)

postconditions.expression: isinstance(output, str) and output.strip().isdigit() or (output.strip() == '-1' if False else True)
postconditions.description: The output is a single non-negative integer representing the minimum total cost.

The output equals the minimum total length of cables required to connect all Byteland and disputed cities into one component and all Berland and disputed cities into one component, accounting for shared edges between disputed cities.

postconditions.expression: len([x for x, c in cities if c in ['B', 'P']]) >= 1 and len([x for x, c in cities if c in ['R', 'P']]) >= 1
postconditions.description: The solution assumes valid inputs where at least one city exists for each required subset (Byteland+Disputed and Berland+Disputed), ensuring a connected graph is possible.
